pass1_summary: A student guide for a CTE Mobile Lab unit covering two modules: 3D pen design and construction of a 3D house structure, and a dental care module introducing tooth anatomy, decay prevention, and virtual dental procedures. Includes learning objectives, step-by-step activities, check-for-understanding questions, and printable worksheets. A CTE program guide containing multi-station learning activities across health sciences (dental X-ray interpretation), computer science (cryptography/code breaking), welding simulation, and aviation/flight training. Includes student worksheets, check-for-understanding questions, and mobile lab instructions organized by grade level or module (pages 12-22).
